title: Extended color palette
slide_intent: Teach designers to vary the personality of a communication while maintaining enough repetition for it to belong to the same family.
strategic_value: A controlled set of tonal families can distinguish programs and items without displacing the primary red and gray.
demonstration: Rows of circular swatches compare light, medium and dark variants across nine color families. Callouts connect individual swatches with red and medal colors.
practical_value: Choose the primary palette and a secondary family for one item. Use shades within that family for its gradients.

content_islands.name: Usage notes
content_islands.spec: Separate the uses for large fields and highlights from the advice to limit the number of hues.

content_islands.name: Hue-family swatches
content_islands.spec: Group three tonal samples per named hue. Set complementary warm, cool and gray families in parallel columns.

content_islands.name: Named correspondences
content_islands.spec: Use leaders to identify swatches associated with Special Olympics Red, gold, bronze and silver.
